title: Cross-System Relationship Map
summary: distinguish shipped Semantic Token and Tag document projections from proposed Project State and Resolver relationships
content_html:
Cross-System Relationship Map

Purpose And Reading Guide

This map separates two shipped cross-system projections from proposed Project State, Resolver Token, and Tag Semantic Token behavior. Solid edges are verified current generation or consumption. Dashed edges and labels containing proposed describe architecture only; they must not be read as shipped files or services.

Diagram

flowchart TB
    accTitle: Shipped and proposed cross-system relationship projections
    accDescr: Current Semantic Token and Tag document-location projections are separated from proposed Project State, Resolver Token, and Tag Semantic Token flows.
    subgraph semantic["Shipped: Catalogue Semantic Tokens"]
        direction TB
        catalogue["Catalogue records + published Moments Docs<br/>canonical or published input"]
        targetBuilder["Semantic target lookup<br/>builder"]
        targetLookup["target-lookup.json<br/>generated management projection"]
        docsBuild["Scope Docs build<br/>consumer + producer"]
        rendered["Resolved document links + usage index<br/>generated projection"]
        catalogue --> targetBuilder --> targetLookup --> docsBuild --> rendered
    end
    subgraph tags["Shipped: Tag document associations"]
        direction TB
        registry["tag-registry.json doc_url[]<br/>canonical Tag association"]
        publishedDocs["Published Docs search + manifests<br/>public-safe input"]
        locationBuilder["Document location builder<br/>producer"]
        locations["document-locations.json<br/>generated public projection"]
        picker["Tag document picker<br/>consumer"]
        registry --> picker
        publishedDocs --> locationBuilder --> locations --> picker
    end
    subgraph proposed["Proposed architecture — not shipped"]
        direction TB
        projectEvidence["Project documents folder_path<br/>+ Studio Works project_folder"]
        projectState["Project State generator<br/>proposed"]
        projectLookup["Versioned Project relationship lookup<br/>proposed"]
        resolver["Resolver Token adapter<br/>proposed"]
        resolverOutput["Current related items in built Docs<br/>proposed"]
        tagTokens["Tag Semantic Token target projection<br/>proposed"]
        tagOutput["Resolved Tag link + usage<br/>proposed"]
        projectEvidence -.-> projectState -.-> projectLookup -.-> resolver -.-> resolverOutput
        registry -.-> tagTokens -.-> tagOutput
    end
    rendered ~~~ registry
    picker ~~~ projectEvidence

Artefact Register

artefact or family state and classification producer or owner primary consumer refresh
docs-viewer/data/generated/semantic-tokens/target-lookup.json shipped generated management projection SemanticTargetLookupBuilder managed Docs semantic-token rendering and authoring explicit target refresh from current registered inputs
scope published/documents/semantic-tokens/index.json shipped generated working projection scope Docs build Semantic Tokens report and diagnostics document build; targeted builds preserve untouched rows
studio/data/canonical/tags/tag-registry.json doc_url[] shipped canonical association Tag source model and mutation services Tag Registry UI accepted Tag mutation
public document-locations.json shipped generated public projection document-location builder from already-published Docs products Tag document picker public Docs/search projection build and publication
Project State relationship rows and focused lookup proposed generated projection proposed Project State generator proposed Project report and Resolver adapter planned explicit or bounded post-commit generation
Resolver Token expansion proposed runtime/build projection proposed registered resolver adapter built managed/public document planned containing-document build; never refreshes Project State

Notes

  • Semantic target refresh and document rebuild are separate. Refreshing the target lookup does not silently rebuild every token-bearing document.
  • The public document contains ordinary resolved links. It does not receive the management target lookup or a client-side semantic resolver.
  • Tag Registry doc_url[] is the current ordered canonical association. document-locations.json supplies public-safe titles and locations for selection; it is not Tag authority.
  • Document lifecycle remains independent of Tag links. Stale URLs can remain valid stored associations and are not inferred or repaired from titles or current UI context.
  • The proposed Project State model is folder-centred. Docs Viewer folder_path and Studio Work project_folder remain different identities connected only through the planned read-only relationship observer.
  • The existing var/studio/reports/project-state.md workflow is an image audit, not the proposed Project State relationship model.
  • Proposed Resolver expansion is one hop and read-only. It does not scan live owners, mutate source, recursively traverse relationships, or refresh Project State.

What This Does Not Include

  • Catalogue public page projections already covered by the Catalogue map;
  • Docs Viewer tree, manifest, search, and publication topology already covered by the Docs Viewer map;
  • Tag aliases, assignments, mutation planning, or future Registry migrations;
  • exact proposed Project State row schemas or Resolver Token syntax;
  • proposed SSP delivery sequencing and migration detail; or
  • graph traversal, ranking, inference, or automatic dependent-document rebuilds.

Possible Enhancements

  • Promote each relationship family into its own child if one diagram can no longer preserve the shipped/proposed boundary clearly.
  • Add Tag Semantic Tokens after their canonical association migration and target projection are actually delivered.
  • Replace the proposed Project/Resolver section with current exact files, producers, and tests after the owning deliveries complete.

Authorities

Semantic Tokens Architecture owns semantic resolution and usage. Tag Registry owns current tag_registry_v5 associations. Project State Concept And Architecture and Resolver Tokens Architecture own the proposed flows.

Current implementation evidence is docs-viewer/build/docs_builder/semantic_target_lookup.py, studio/services/tags/tag_source_model.py, studio/services/tags/tag_registry_mutations.py, and docs-viewer/services/docs_document_location_projection.py; focused coverage includes docs-viewer/tests/python/test_semantic_target_lookup.py, studio/tests/python/test_tag_source_model.py, studio/tests/python/test_tag_registry_mutations.py, and docs-viewer/tests/python/test_build_document_locations.py.
